description: This file `useQueries.js` provides a set of custom React hooks and data fetcher functions for retrieving dashboard-related data from a Supabase backend. It centralizes queries for KPIs, visitor stats, task distributions, recent activities, and current campaigns, primarily for dashboard display and widget population.

methods.name: useQueries()
methods.description: Custom React hook that returns methods to fetch various dashboard data asynchronously, including KPIs, visitor statistics, task distributions, recent activities, and active campaigns.

methods.name: getKpis
methods.description: Fetches sales, new customers, in-progress projects, and new applications for the current month, returning mapped KPI tiles.

methods.name: getVisitorStats
methods.description: Retrieves visitor data for the past specified number of months and normalizes it into monthly series for new vs returning visits.

methods.name: getTasksDistribution
methods.description: Fetches tasks and computes distribution by status for dashboard donut chart visualization.

methods.name: getRecentActivities
methods.description: Fetches recent activity logs, attempting to include user info via join, with fallback if join fails, and maps the activities.

methods.name: getActiveCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves the latest active campaign for display on the dashboard.
